articles.summary: Richmond, VA, October 29, 2026 - The Board of Directors of NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) declared a quarterly dividend in the amount of $3.25 per share on the common stock of the Corporation, an increase of $0.25, or approximately 8%, as compared to the last quarterly dividend of $3.00 per share.
articles.title: NewMarket Corporation Increases Quarterly Dividend - NewMarket Corporation

articles.summary: Richmond, VA, October 5, 2026 - NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) announced today it expects to release third quarter 2026 earnings at the close of business on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.
articles.title: NewMarket Corporation Schedules Conference Call and Webcast to Review Third Quarter 2026 Results - NewMarket Corporation

articles.summary: Richmond, VA, October 28, 2026 – NewMarket Corporation (NYSE:NEU) Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Thomas E. Gottwald, released the following earnings report of the Company’s operations for the third quarter and first nine months of 2026.
articles.title: NewMarket Corporation Reports Third Quarter and First Nine Months 2026 Results - NewMarket Corporation
